mapper.select: SELECT type.id as serve_type_id, type.name as serve_type_name, type.serve_type_icon, serve.city_code, serve.id as serve_id, item.id as serve_item_id, item.name as serve_item_name, item.serve_item_icon, item.sort_num as serve_item_sort_num FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON item.id = serve.serve_item_id inner JOIN serve_type AS type ON type.id = item.serve_type_id WHERE serve.region_id = #{regionId} AND serve.sale_status = 2 ORDER BY type.sort_num, item.sort_num

SELECT serve.id, serve.sale_status, serve.serve_item_id, item.name AS serve_item_name, item.serve_type_id, serve.region_id, item.reference_price, serve.price, serve.is_hot, serve.create_time, serve.update_time, type.id serve_type_id, type.name serve_type_name FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id inner JOIN serve_type AS type ON item.serve_type_id = type.id WHERE serve.region_id = #{regionId}

SELECT serve.id, serve.serve_item_id, item.name AS serve_item_name, item.img AS serve_item_img, item.unit, serve.price, item.detail_img, serve.city_code FROM serve INNER JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id WHERE serve.region_id = #{regionId} AND serve.sale_status = 2 AND serve.is_hot = 1 AND item.active_status = 2 ORDER BY serve.hot_time_stamp DESC, serve.update_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.serve_item_id, si.name AS serve_item_name, si.img AS serve_item_img, si.unit, s.price, si.detail_img, s.city_code FROM serve s INNER JOIN serve_item si ON s.serve_item_id = si.id WHERE s.id = #{id} and s.sale_status = 2 and si.active_status = 2

SELECT s.id, s.serve_item_id, si.name AS serve_item_name, si.img AS serve_item_img, si.unit, s.price, si.detail_img, s.city_code FROM serve s INNER JOIN serve_item si ON s.serve_item_id = si.id WHERE s.city_code = #{cityCode} and si.serve_type_id = #{serveTypeId} and s.sale_status = 2 ORDER BY si.sort_num

SELECT DISTINCT st.id AS serve_type_id, st.name AS serve_type_name, st.img AS serve_type_img, st.sort_num AS serve_type_sort_num FROM serve s INNER JOIN serve_item si ON s.serve_item_id = si.id INNER JOIN serve_type st ON si.serve_type_id = st.id WHERE s.region_id = #{regionId} and s.sale_status = 2 ORDER BY st.sort_num

SELECT serve.id, serve.sale_status, serve.serve_item_id, serve.price, serve.city_code, item.name AS serve_item_name, item.img AS serve_item_img, item.detail_img, item.unit, st.id as serve_type_id, st.name as serve_type_name FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id inner join serve_type st on st.id=item.serve_type_id WHERE serve.sale_status = 2 AND serve.id = #{id}
